name: Validate Pharmacy Extraction
plugin_description: Validates the structure and types of a pharmacy extraction JSON array
action_description: Validates each pharmacy entry in an extracted pharmacies JSON string for required fields, types, and enum values

inputs.name: extracted_pharmacies_json
inputs.label: Extracted Pharmacies JSON
inputs.description: JSON array string of pharmacy objects to validate, each with name, type, usage_status, geographic_search, etc.

outputs.name: invalid_json
outputs.label: Invalid JSON
outputs.description: True if the input failed validation, false if it passed
